reference_verification.AAL_HLD: Official article viewed; mathematical explanation only, no code copied. Original article license not asserted to be CC0.
reference_verification.Nyaan: Official repository master LICENSE is CC0-1.0; catalogue/verification problem references only; no source implementation copied.
reference_verification.ACL: Official master LICENSE is CC0-1.0; API and mathematical complexity used as reference, iterative blocking-flow source written independently.
reference_verification.Luzhiled: Catalogue viewed to identify useful algorithms; no implementation copied or relicensed.

coverage.SCC: independent reachability transitive closure; all-pairs equivalence; condensation duplicates/topological order; arbitrary/self/multiple edges; graph constructor; rebuild/copy/move;300000 chain and SCC
coverage.TwoSAT: independent full truth-table enumeration n0..10; clause/implication/force/XOR/equality; SAT assignment/UNSAT/repeated solve; copy/move/stale-answer checks
coverage.HLD: independent BFS path per ordered vertex pair, string-equivalent order/direction, edge-LCA exclusion, forest/arbitrary root, subtree,ancestor,jump,kth ancestor;copy/move/rebuild failures;300000 deep chain
coverage.MaxFlow: independent Edmonds-Karp and exhaustive cuts; residual conservation and original capacities; limits/multiple flow calls/change/edges/mincut/self/multi/antiparallel edges;uint64/uint8 bound;350000 deep chain
coverage.allocation: 65 injected bad_alloc +895 successful operations per configuration; source inputs/answers and logical prior states preserved on failure; zero live allocation delta after destruction
